import io,json,unittest
from pathlib import Path
import tests.test_gmyhf_answer_repairs as test
m=test.repair
source=Path(m.__file__).read_text()
mutants=[('跳过只读开关', 'if not apply:', 'if False:', 'test_plan_does_not_upload_or_claim_completion'),('忽略题面漂移', "require(observed == entry['checks']['statement']['field_sha256'],", 'require(True,', 'test_changed_statement_stops_before_upload'),('关闭全部哈希保护', 'if not condition:', 'if False:', 'test_changed_input_stops_before_upload')]
results=[]
for name,old,new,method in mutants:
 assert source.count(old)==1
 exec(compile(source.replace(old,new),m.__file__,'exec'),m.__dict__)
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(unittest.TestSuite([test.AnswerRepairTests(method)]))
 assert not result.wasSuccessful(),name
 results.append({'mutation':name,'test':method,'detected':True})
exec(compile(source,m.__file__,'exec'),m.__dict__)
Path('/tmp/gmyhf-answer-repair-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('3种变异全部被检出')
